_source: Live Ivanti ServiceReqTemplates / ServiceReqTemplateParams / ServiceReqTemplateParamValids and validation lists, read 2026-09-27 via ithelp.retailinmotion.com OData. Hidden helper fields, Ivanti EPM automation flags and person-list values are excluded; person lists become Jira user pickers. Section rules are single-controller because Jira Forms only honours one controller per section on the portal.

CUSTOMERS: Easyjet (EZY) NOT VIA IVANTI See Ivanti Q&A#10129*
